gloss: feeling of helplessness; sense of powerlessness

definitions.gloss: feeling of helplessness; sense of powerlessness
definitions.explanation: The emotional state of feeling unable to do anything or make a difference. Often experienced in the face of overwhelming circumstances.

examples.japanese: {無力感|むりょくかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われた→襲う：01915_osou⟧。
examples.english: I was overcome by a feeling of helplessness.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧{無力感|むりょくかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つらい。
examples.english: The helplessness of not being able to do anything is painful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{無力感|むりょくかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じ→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧はいられない。
examples.english: In the face of a major disaster, you can't help but feel powerless.

notes:
USAGE:
Often used with verbs expressing being overwhelmed or experiencing emotions: {無力感|むりょくかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われる→襲う：01915_osou⟧, {無力感|むりょくかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧, {無力感|むりょくかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苛|さいな}まれる→苛む：28648_sainamu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {無力感|むりょくかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{襲|おそ}われる→襲う：01915_osou⟧ (to be overwhelmed by helplessness)
- {無力感|むりょくかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{感|かん}じる→感じる：02044_kanjiru⟧ (to feel helpless)
- {無力感|むりょくかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{苛|さいな}まれる→苛む：28648_sainamu⟧ (to be tormented by helplessness)
- ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{無力感|むりょくかん} (deep sense of powerlessness)

FORMS:
⟦{無|む}→無：17750_mu⟧ (without) + {力|りょく} (power) + ⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ (feeling). The 〜⟦{感|かん}→〜感：28578_kan⟧ suffix creates emotion nouns from abstract concepts.
